Chapter 713: Chapter 14: The Theory of Heaven’s Gate (Please Subscribe) _3

“””

Of course, those powerful settlements and cities are capable of indiscriminately hunting down those ferocious beasts, and safety need not be mentioned.

But to settle in such places comes at a steep price, something ordinary people like Pado wouldn’t even dream of.

…..

That night.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

...

At this moment, every bone in his body was trembling, and his skin was continuously oozing black impurities.

As a Tenth Rank Evolver, even in this Two-dimensional World, he could initiate a transformation akin to ‘Marrow Cleansing’ by leveraging control over his own body.

“I now, after all, possess the power to protect myself.”

Lin Yuan breathed a sigh of relief, knowing that the most dangerous times for powerhouses from the Main Universe who fall into this Two-dimensional World are the first three days.

The first two days were spent in slumber, and the third in adaptation.

Once those three days were endured, one could, to a greater or lesser extent, gain some self-protective abilities based on one’s own capabilities.

“My physical body now, has it reached the level of a ‘witch’ in this world?” Lin Yuan wondered silently to himself.

The cultivation in this Two-dimensional World was extremely straightforward, being a constant enhancement of one’s physical strength, progressing from weak to strong: Witch, Witch King, Witch Emperor, Witch Emperor.

It was said that above the Witch Emperor existed the Witch Ancestor, but they were so rare that whenever one appeared, all beings across the continent would worship them.

According to the information Lin Yuan indirectly obtained from the natives other than Pado,

a Witch Ancestor would be born in this world only every several thousand to tens of thousands of years.

“Witch Ancestor?”

“It’s nothing more than having transformed the physical body to the limit.”

“Even Eighth Layer beings, given enough time, can easily achieve it.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, foreseeing that as time went by, and the strong from the various races of the Main Universe gradually adapted, a group of extremely terrifying powerhouses would emerge on this continent.

“The Witch Ancestor is just the beginning.” Lin Yuan’s expression remained calm.

A level easily attainable by Eighth Tier beings, not to mention those of Ninth Rank, Tenth Rank, and even Eleventh-Rank Life.

…

In the following time.

Lin Yuan would rest during the day, and at night, he would secretly leave to hunt those terrifying beasts.

After one transformation, Lin Yuan realized that in order to continue to develop the potential of his physical body, he needed to consume enough energy.

But where could that energy come from?

The force of heaven and earth?

The concept of heaven and earth’s force did not exist in the Two-dimensional World.

All energy was acquired in the most primitive way:

Devouring other powerful ferocious beasts.

Boom!

A ten-meter tall giant elephant fell to the ground, and Lin Yuan sat cross-legged in front of the giant elephant, taking the most core part of its flesh and blood and eating it raw.

Rustling.

A great deal of blood energy poured into his body and was quickly absorbed and refined by Lin Yuan, slowly strengthening his physique.

Time passed.

Before long, over half a month had elapsed.

“Witch King.”

Lin Yuan’s body underwent a second transformation.

His strength and speed greatly improved, far surpassing that of a previous ‘witch’.

Based on the scarce information from Pado and others, Lin Yuan should now be a Witch King.

A Witch King Level powerhouse could already command a region; the strongest in an ordinary settlement was no more than a Witch King.

Even within city-level forces, a Witch King carried significant influence and belonged to the ranks of the top powerhouses.

“Huff, huff…” Lin Yuan took a light breath, having become a Witch King at the cost of hunting down and devouring all the beasts with a size greater than ten meters within ten thousand miles.

As for those under ten meters? Their contained blood energy was too little, Lin Yuan couldn’t be bothered to take action, and he left some for Pado and his people anyway.

If the nearby ferocious beasts were exterminated, Pado and his group of natives would likely have to migrate to other places to live.

And on this continent, migration was very dangerous.

“However, I can go to the nearest settlement tomorrow.” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Every two months, Pado and his people would join forces to make a trip to a settlement, to exchange goods they had gathered.

…

Main Universe.

Virtual World.

While over half a month had passed in the Two-dimensional World, little more than an hour had gone by in the Main Universe.

Personal Space.

Lin Yuan and Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, sat opposite each other.

Under the descent of that White Paper, an Avatar of Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, was also caught up in Battlefield A098.

Therefore, it was naturally swept into the Two-dimensional World within the White Paper.

However, Nalan had better luck than Lin Yuan; his Landing place was a city, and by chance, he was found by the daughter of the city’s master.

The city master’s daughter immediately took Nalan back for treatment.

“Here are the cultivation laws I’ve collected from that Two-dimensional World, take a look.” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, immediately took out dozens of cultivation laws and passed them to Lin Yuan.

Nalan was favored by the city master’s daughter and had access to high-level materials, especially the cultivation laws.

In that Two-dimensional World, cultivation laws were almost monopolized, and ordinary people wouldn’t know how much they would have to pay to get their hands on them.

“Thank you.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

Through these cultivation laws, Lin Yuan could more directly observe the essence of the power of that world.

When Lin Yuan established the Martial Arts Evolution System, he also observed a great deal of other evolution systems, even those from other dimensional worlds.

Therefore—

Observing the cultivation laws of the Two-dimensional World would also be of great use to him.

“By the way, I’ve heard some news,” Nalan, the Deputy Tower Master, said softly as if he had just thought of something.

“What news?” Lin Yuan inquired immediately.

“Heaven’s Gate,” replied Nalan with brevity.

“Heaven’s Gate?” Lin Yuan’s eyebrows rose.

“According to the records of the city I was in, every ten thousand years, Heaven’s Gate would manifest in the world. At that time, only Witch Emperor Level and Witch Ancestor Level beings could approach ‘Heaven’s Gate’.”

“In the end, only one individual can stand before Heaven’s Gate.”

“If someone could open ‘Heaven’s Gate’, they would leave this world and head to a higher-level one,” Nalan spoke with a heavy tone.

While he was not certain whether opening the Heaven’s Gate meant returning to the Main Universe, it was the only method he knew of so far that explicitly mentioned leaving this world.
